description: Abstract class for processing user-related RPC messages in the Thingsboard edge service, including user creation, update, deletion, and credentials management.

classes.name: BaseUserProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing user processing functionalities for edge RPC, including user creation, update, deletion, and credentials management.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user based on the provided UserUpdateMsg, handling email duplication and validation.

methods.name: updateUserEmailIfDuplicateExists
methods.description: Checks for existing user with the same email and renames the email if a duplicate is found.

methods.name: deleteUserAndPushEntityDeletedEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Deletes a user and pushes an entity deleted event to the rule engine.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID if exists.

methods.name: updateUserCredentials
methods.description: Updates user credentials based on UserCredentialsUpdateMsg.

methods.name: addRemovedUserMetadata
methods.description: Adds user metadata to message metadata before deletion event.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Abstract method to set customer ID for a user, to be implemented in subclasses.
